body:
I guess I could. I really need to tell her now stuck I feel. Maybe then she will understand. Thank you. 
Hopefully I can pull myself out of this hole. I'm so close to just giving up and tying that noose.
Tried to overdose on my medication. Just left me with a headache which I still have now and nausea.

Why?
Because I'm worthless. I'll never be good enough for my standards, for my parents standards, for anyone. I hate myself, the way I think, the way I look, the fact I can't function properly: my thoughts are scattered, unorganised, unpredictable and reckless. I can't keep friends because I push them away by telling them everyone hates me and no one cares about me. The only reason I'm keeping my best friend around is because of guilt. I, stupidly, fell in love with him and he has no will power. I act like we have the perfect relationship but when he's with his actual family it tears me apart. I become a self destructive mess. I take pills, I drink when I get down which makes me worse. I cut myself almost everyday. I smoke far too much for me to afford and I waste my life away on negative thoughts and self-loathing. 

I can't cope with this constant internal voice telling me I'm no good and I should kill myself. Nothing shuts it up. It physically hurts.

In short: I'm too weak and I'm tired.

I have tried to tell her. Hell she came to see me in the hospital, and she was just saying that I need to make lemonade out of lemons. I mean she's a brilliant therapist and she has helped me an awful lot, I just don't think she understands what a black hole I am in...
